zach-lieberman--audio-in-ar-space.why_en: Every sound stays where it was made, so walking back through the trail plays it again.
zach-lieberman--audio-in-ar-space.why_zh: 每个声音都留在它发出的位置，沿原路走回去就能再次听到。

kiyoshi-kiyokawa--somen-to-ramen.why_en: Plain noodles shown as ramen start to taste like ramen, so sight changes flavor.
kiyoshi-kiyokawa--somen-to-ramen.why_zh: 素面被显示成拉面后，吃起来也像拉面，视觉改变了味觉。

nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.why_en: A wall painted over every day shows its earlier layers in place, so the phone becomes a window into the past.
nathan-gitter--time-travel-graffiti.why_zh: 每天都被重新涂鸦的墙在原处显出过去的样子，手机成了看向过去的窗口。

jonas-jongejan--ar-wormhole.why_en: Step through a portal and look around the same place as it was ten seconds ago.
jonas-jongejan--ar-wormhole.why_zh: 穿过一道传送门，看到的是十秒钟前的同一个地方。

yuta-itoh--laplacian-vision.why_en: A line in the air shows where a thrown ball is about to go, so you see a moment into the future.
yuta-itoh--laplacian-vision.why_zh: 空中的一条线提前画出球将要飞到哪里，让人看见下一刻。

yuta-itoh--adaptivisor.why_en: Sunglasses that darken only the glaring pixels of the world and leave the rest untouched.
yuta-itoh--adaptivisor.why_zh: 一副只遮暗刺眼部分、其余保持原样的像素级墨镜。

brad-dwyer--magic-sudoku.why_en: Point at a paper Sudoku and the answers appear written in its empty squares.
brad-dwyer--magic-sudoku.why_zh: 对准纸上的数独，答案直接写进空格里。

morten-just--stenciling-ar.why_en: A picture cast onto paper lets anyone trace a good drawing by hand.
morten-just--stenciling-ar.why_zh: 把参考图投到纸上，任何人都能照着描出一幅好画。

hart-woolery--instasaber.why_en: A rolled-up sheet of paper turns into a glowing lightsaber in your hand.
hart-woolery--instasaber.why_zh: 一张卷起来的纸在手中变成发光的光剑。

abhishek-singh--laser-cat-ar.why_en: The whole game is one gesture: tease a virtual kitten on your floor with a laser dot.
abhishek-singh--laser-cat-ar.why_zh: 整个游戏只有一件事：用激光点逗地板上的虚拟小猫。

lucas-rizzotto--cybersnake.why_en: You are the snake, walking through your home and dodging your own growing tail.
lucas-rizzotto--cybersnake.why_zh: 你就是那条蛇，在家里走动并躲开自己越来越长的尾巴。

marshmallow-laser-feast--treehugger-wawo.why_en: Hugging a tree is the interface that reveals the water flowing inside it.
marshmallow-laser-feast--treehugger-wawo.why_zh: 拥抱一棵树就是交互方式，由此看见树里流动的水。

marshmallow-laser-feast--in-the-eyes-of-.why_en: Stand in a forest and see it through the senses of a mosquito, frog or owl.
marshmallow-laser-feast--in-the-eyes-of-.why_zh: 站在森林里，用蚊子、青蛙或猫头鹰的感官去看这片森林。

jun-nishida--smaller-person-experience.why_en: A low camera and small hands let an adult see and grasp the world as a child does.
jun-nishida--smaller-person-experience.why_zh: 低处的摄像头和缩小的手，让成年人像孩子一样看世界、抓东西。

jason-orlosky--halo-content.why_en: Notifications move out of the way when a person walks into view and form a halo around their face.
jason-orlosky--halo-content.why_zh: 有人走进视野时，通知会自动让开，在对方脸周围围成一圈光环。

metaio--thermal-touch.why_en: The warm spot your fingertip leaves on any surface becomes the click.
metaio--thermal-touch.why_zh: 指尖在任何表面上留下的余温就是一次点击。

daniel-rozin--penguins-mirror.why_en: Hundreds of toy penguins turn their black backs or white bellies to form your silhouette.
daniel-rozin--penguins-mirror.why_zh: 几百只玩具企鹅转身露出黑背或白肚，拼出你的身影。

golan-levin--augmented-hand-series.why_en: Your own hand grows an extra finger on screen, live, and it feels uncanny.
golan-levin--augmented-hand-series.why_zh: 屏幕上你自己的手实时多长出一根手指，让人感到怪异。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--level-of-confidenc.why_en: A face-recognition camera searches every visitor's face for 43 missing students, turning surveillance into a memorial.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--level-of-confidenc.why_zh: 人脸识别在每位观众脸上寻找 43 名失踪学生，把监控变成纪念。

judith-amores--invisible-highway.why_en: Draw a road in AR and a real toy car drives along it.
judith-amores--invisible-highway.why_zh: 在增强现实中画一条路，真实的玩具车就沿着它开。

nexus-studios--hotstepper.why_en: A small character walks ahead of you on the real street to show the way.
nexus-studios--hotstepper.why_zh: 一个小人在真实街道上走在你前面带路。

trixi-studios--take-on-me-ar.why_en: Step through a door into a pencil-sketch world where even your own hand turns into line art.
trixi-studios--take-on-me-ar.why_zh: 穿过一扇门进入铅笔素描世界，连自己的手也变成线条。

abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.why_en: The girl from The Ring crawls out of your own TV and into your living room.
abhishek-singh--the-ring-ar.why_zh: 《午夜凶铃》里的女孩从你家电视里爬进客厅。

craig-winslow--light-capsules-neon-museu.why_en: Projection fakes the glow of broken neon signs so they seem lit again.
craig-winslow--light-capsules-neon-museu.why_zh: 投影模仿出光芒，让坏掉的霓虹招牌看起来重新亮起。

elevenplay-mikiko--shadow.why_en: Drones carry the spotlights, so as they fly the dancer's shadows multiply and turn.
elevenplay-mikiko--shadow.why_zh: 聚光灯由无人机携带，它们一飞，舞者的影子就分裂、旋转。

pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.why_en: Objects move your hand with electrical stimulation to show you how to use them.
pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.why_zh: 物体用电刺激直接带动你的手，告诉你该怎么用它。

shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.why_en: Four people see through each other's eyes at once and try to play hide-and-seek.
shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.why_zh: 四个人同时看到彼此的视角，再试着玩捉迷藏。

golan-levin--arkit-re-code-of-jeffrey-sh.why_en: An empty plinth holds a golden calf that exists only through the phone.
golan-levin--arkit-re-code-of-jeffrey-sh.why_zh: 空的底座上立着一头只有通过手机才能看到的金牛。

daito-manabe--fencing-visualized.why_en: Sword tips too fast to see are drawn as trails over live footage, so the bout becomes readable.
daito-manabe--fencing-visualized.why_zh: 快得看不清的剑尖被画成轨迹叠在直播画面上，比赛一下子看懂了。

memo-akten--learning-to-see.why_en: A neural network sees cloth and cables on a table as waves or fire, showing that a machine sees only what it was trained on.
memo-akten--learning-to-see.why_zh: 神经网络把桌上的布和线看成海浪或火焰，说明机器只能看见它学过的东西。

krzysztof-wodiczko--queen-victoria.why_en: A colonial statue takes on the faces and voices of local residents and tells their stories.
krzysztof-wodiczko--queen-victoria.why_zh: 一座殖民时代的雕像换上当地居民的脸和声音，讲述他们的故事。

nathan-gitter--rainbrow.why_en: Raise your eyebrows to fly up: your face is the whole controller.
nathan-gitter--rainbrow.why_zh: 扬起眉毛就往上飞，你的脸就是整个手柄。
